description: Connect to a WebView page and start buffering its console output and uncaught exceptions (the last 1000 entries). Recent messages the engine still holds are replayed on attach, but attach before reproducing an issue to be sure nothing is missed. Only observes the page: it is not reloaded or modified. May be refused while Chrome DevTools (chrome://inspect) is attached to the same page; close it and retry. Calling it again for an attached page reuses the existing session.

target_id.description: Target id from list_targets, e.g. "<serial>/<socket>/<page id>"

name: attach
title: Attach to a page
